title: kb-retriever v1.0.7 verification — read-side symlink containment (read+write gate) + reference cleanup
clawscanTrigger: v1.0.6 verdict=suspicious/high — aig T09 warning at scripts/search_kb.py:52: "Symlinked files can escape the authorized knowledge-base root" (read side was unguarded: v1.0.5 only closed the write side); plus skillspector AE1 (HIGH, coverage): SKILL.md referenced assets/readme/community-qr.png which the scanner could not fully inspect
fix: scripts/pathguard.py: gate generalized from write-only to read + write (new read_within(); docstring now covers both directions, fail closed)

scripts/search_kb.py (the flagged helper): root resolved via realpath; every candidate entry resolved to its real path and checked against the root — escaped entries are skipped and counted, never opened; symlinked folders pruned from traversal; reads use the validated real path

scripts/build_index.py: read side gated too — README reads and per-entry size/list reads go through the same real-path check; escaped entries skipped and counted; counters disclosed in the summary line

scripts/extract_pdf_text.py / convert_pdf_to_images.py: source PDF resolved to its real path and printed ([read] line); reads use that real file; output containment still derived from the real source directory

SKILL.md: removed the explicit asset path/filename reference that triggered the coverage finding (now generic wording); added read-boundary statements to the capability/boundary section, the hard-constraint block and the frontmatter description
manifest.json: version 1.0.7, description + permissions.notes now state the read boundary
README.md / README.en.md: added a bounded-both-ways note next to the existing write warning

references/pdf_reading.md: removed the stale unguarded copy of extract_pdf_text.py (code drift — agents could copy an unguarded variant); the doc now points at the shipped script and states its boundary; added a write-boundary note to the OCR/render snippets
harness: tmp/kb_v107_verify.py — 29 checks, real symlinks created on disk

read_side: search over escaped symlinked file: 0 hits, escaped entries skipped and counted, outside content never printed
listing excludes escaped file and escaped folder entries, keeps in-root files
in-root symlink (target inside KB) still listed/followed
write_side: file symlinked to an outside index: outside file byte-identical after --force run
no data_structure.md generated outside the KB
pathguard_unit: read_within allows in-root, raises PathEscapeError out-of-root

attack_scenarios_tested: KB contains link_secret.md -> <outside>/secret.md ; searching the sentinel string returns 0 hits and never prints outside content (escaped=2 counted)
KB contains link_outdir -> <outside> (directory symlink); traversal never enters it, no outside entry appears in --list
KB contains sub/data_structure.md as a symlink to an outside file; build_index --force leaves the outside file byte-identical and refuses the out-of-root write
in-root symlink (KB/in_link.md -> KB/a.md) keeps working, so legitimate links are not broken
verification_note: 待发布后跑 clawhub skill verify 复核（目标：security.status=clean / verdict=benign），并核对 summary/displayName 等元数据漂移
